_: Little Big Questions, rain, SILENT STORY (no narration; the picture explains; music and sound design carry it; a few big words set in code). One fixed Fable view of one lifted Cutaway slice (a hillside with a brook, a lake and groundwater) in a living world, no cuts. This beat sheet is the film's source of truth for picture, words, sound and music; facts in docs/research/KIDS_FACTS_2026-10.md 2.2 (the dinosaur-water claim is NOT used). Times in seconds, 73 s total, timed to the music edit.

beats.name: hook
beats.picture: A sunny morning on a lifted slice of hillside: a little brook runs down into a lake, a village and hills carry on all round, a river winds off toward the sea at the horizon. The question sits in the sky. The snail mascot looks up from the front corner.
beats.sound: morning birds, the trickle of the brook, a soft breeze
beats.music: the first flute line alone: the first drops of a spring (recording 0:00)

beats.name: the sun warms
beats.picture: The sun climbs and glows warm; the lake and the far sea glitter. The air over the water begins to shimmer.
beats.sound: the glitter of water, a warm swell, soft chimes
beats.music: the second flute line joins the first (two springs)

beats.name: invisible water
beats.picture: The warmed water rises as invisible vapour: pale, wavy, shimmering ribbons climb from the lake and the sea, getting thinner as they go. Nothing is seen but the shimmer.
beats.sound: a rising shimmer, tiny glassy tinkles
beats.music: the rippling lines climb together; joint of the edit at 16.2 s (recording 0:16.2 into 0:44.4)

beats.name: tiny drops
beats.picture: High up it is cold: the ribbons' tips turn into tiny white dots that gather above the slice, and a soft cloud begins to grow there.
beats.sound: tiny drops of sound gathering, a soft rising pad of air
beats.music: the springs swell together, more and more instruments

beats.name: a million
beats.picture: A magnifier window opens on the cloud: a crowd of tiny drops bumps and sticks, pairs become bigger drops, bigger drops join again, until one fat raindrop is left and it falls out of the window as the cloud turns heavy and grey.
beats.sound: each join a soft blip, the last one a plump drop
beats.music: the swell climbs to the river theme: the first fat drop falls on its entry at 33.9 s (recording 1:02.1)

beats.name: first drops
beats.picture: The first raindrops fall from the cloud, a few and then many, soft and happy: ripples in the lake, glistening leaves. A child in a yellow raincoat and red boots runs in and opens a yellow umbrella. The snail stretches its eyes up and wiggles: it loves the rain.
beats.sound: first single drops, then soft rain, the umbrella opening with a pop
beats.music: the river theme enters (33.9 s) and carries the rain

beats.name: soaking in
beats.picture: The rain soaks into the hillside: the cut face darkens from the top down, drops sink through the soil to the sandy layer, and the water in it rises. The brook swells, the lake fills, a paper boat sails down the brook into the lake. The child splashes in a puddle.
beats.sound: rain on leaves and soil, trickles, the brook gurgling, splashes
beats.music: the first statement of the river theme, ending at 48.8 s (recording 1:17.0)

beats.name: the sun again
beats.picture: The cloud thins and drifts, the rain stops and the sun breaks out; the ground glistens and a rainbow arcs over the slice on the big phrase at 52.6 s.
beats.sound: the last drops, birds start again, a bright shimmer for the rainbow
beats.music: joint of the edit at 48.8 s (1:17.0 into 11:52.2): the broad river theme in major bursts out; the rainbow on its big phrase (recording 11:56.0)

beats.name: around and around
beats.picture: The river runs to the sea; far away the sea glitters and new shimmer rises from the lake and the sea, and a small new cloud starts again. Round and around it goes.
beats.sound: water running on, a breeze, a bright rising shimmer again
beats.music: the great chord at about 60.3 s, then the afterglow

beats.name: your rain
beats.picture: The rainbow glows, the small new cloud floats on. The snail waves; the child jumps in the puddle. The closing question hangs in the sky.
beats.sound: soft birds, a last splash, a drop
beats.music: afterglow, then the piece's own two final chords at 68.0 and 70.0 s (recording 12:45.2 and 12:47.2)

words_rules: Set in code (Fable lettering, large, readable on a phone, 2.5 s minimum on screen); no em dash, en dash or three dots; never drawn by a model.
sound_rules: Music is the voice of the film: foreground (about -16 LUFS integrated). Every event the picture shows has a real CC0 recording from the sfx-bank. Nothing harsh, sudden or scary: soft attacks, no loud stingers, true peak under -1.5 dBTP.

music.piece: Smetana, Má Vlast, no. 2, Vltava (The Moldau)
